_comment: gentle-eye project-local tier ordering — USER PICK [1,2,3,5,7] from the full 13-tier ladder, in SOURCE ORDER (2026-05-28, corrected). Keeps the BUILT local horsepower tiers (local-coder-heavy 50GB qwen3-coder-next + local-reasoning-heavy 70b deepseek-r1) — do NOT drop these.
